name: WaveChunkId
meaning: FOURCCs the wave reader compares against, stored as little-endian dwords in the code.

name: MMCK_DATA
meaning: 'data' - preset into ckData.ckid before every mmioDescend in WaveFile_Open and WaveFile_ResetFile.

name: MMIO_FOURCC_MEM
meaning: 'MEM ' - MMIOINFO.fccIOProc for the in-memory open path of WaveFile_Open. No caller uses it.
